description: Pre-trade safety check for a tokenized US stock: verifies it is the issuer's genuine token rather than a copycat, and whether it looks safe to buy right now (depeg, thin liquidity, off-hours mispricing, trading halts). Works for any issuer (Backed/xStocks, Ondo, Remora) and any Solana mint or EVM address. Pass ticker (e.g. NVDA, which checks the canonical xStock) or token (a symbol such as AAPLx or AAPLon, or a mint / 0x address). Returns a decision (ok / review / avoid), the issuer, whether the token is verified against the issuer's own registry, and the reasons. Read-only.

ticker.description: US ticker (e.g. NVDA, AAPL) — checks the canonical Backed xStock for it

token.description: OR a specific token: a symbol (AAPLx/AAPLon/TSLAr) or a raw Solana mint / 0x EVM address

name: check_xstock_safety

issuer.description: Issuer the token was checked against

ok.description: true when the token passed the safety gate

verified.description: Whether the mint matches the issuer's registry
